title: Pulsemon
description: An extension of the Cobblemon Modpack created for use in the Pulse Discord. Adds many new features to improve the QOL and World Exploration.
body:
# Pulsemon _An Extension Modpack to Cobblemon_ [![Join on Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de7f2f606702569cd98fc1f6a0b29dbf817dd870.png)](https://discord.gg/BRrvx28HH5) _For Bug Reports Only!_ ## Overview Pulsemon is a lightweight Cobblemon extension mocpack designed to combine the enhanced style of a normal Minecraft modpack with the Cobblemon mod. Focusing on use in a multiplayer setting, but also supporting Singleplayer worlds. ## Key Features - Cobblemon - In-depth Cobblemon Breeding (Cobbreeding) - Linking with Botany Pots - More Move Variety (SimpleTMs) - Detailed Stats for Competitive set Cobblemon - Additional Recipes for Harder to obtain items - Expanded ridable Cobblemon - Better Berry capabilities - Cobblemon Loot integration - Increased Exploration - Biomes O' Plenty - Oh The Biomes We've Gone - Better Dungeons - Re-lootable structures - A New Combat System with Additional Weapons - Simply Swords - Better Combat - Better Enchantment compatibility and merging - Armor and Tool Rarity
